question.problem:
Given that $X$ is a continuous random variable with the following probability density function, compute $\text{E}[X].$ Give your answer rounded to two decimal places.

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{2}}{4}-1, & 2<x<3 \\ \frac{5}{12}, & 3\le x<4\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
For a continuous random variable $X$ with probability density function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S,$ we can calculate the expected value using the following formula:

$$
\text{E}[X]={\int }_{S}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x
$$

 

We compute the expected value of $X$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\int }_{2}^{4}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{2}^{3}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{3}^{4}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{2}^{3}x\cdot (\frac{{x}^{2}}{4}-1)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{3}^{4}x\cdot \frac{5}{12}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{2}^{3}(\frac{{x}^{3}}{4}-x)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{3}^{4}\frac{5x}{12}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={(\frac{{x}^{4}}{16}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{2})|}_{2}^{3}+{\frac{5{x}^{2}}{24}|}_{3}^{4} \\  & =\frac{25}{16}+\frac{35}{24} \\  & =\frac{145}{48} \\  & ≈3.02,\end{aligned}
$$

 

rounded to two decimal places.
